investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell was used to persist a script by adding a Run key entry under HKCU to launch a hidden PowerShell script from C:\ProgramData\winupd.ps1 with bypassed execution policy. The file is downloaded from an external host 91.214.88.109/winupd.ps1 before execution observed in earlier events, indicating potential malicious activity. This pattern matches prior similar alerts and shows persistence and external download indicators, suggesting heightened risk and the need for investigation.
investigation_notes.Persistence technique: Registry Run key modification (HKCU) to launch PowerShell script
investigation_notes.Recent related alerts: SOC-9621 and SOC-9622 observed from same source and endpoint with similar scriptblock
